name: 06-19-merged-wanding-installer-v2
title: Merged CCB-Wanding + AionUI NSIS installer (v2)
description: One-shot NSIS packages AionUi win-unpacked + CCB dist/vendor/seed under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CCB-Wanding; desktop shortcut targets ccb-launch-aionui.cmd so bootstrap runs before AionUI; post-install ensure-wanding-settings + org-server.json seed.
creator: JASMINE145-ACT
notes: 2026-06-20 strict audit: implementation now uses ccb-launch-aionui.cmd for desktop/start-menu launch, exports CCB_INSTALL_DIR/CCB_WANDING_HOME/CCB_WANDING_CONFIG_DIR, route-b prefers launcher env and bundled install discovery before stale fallback slots, and build-wanding.ps1 preinstalls MCP/ppt Python deps into bundled python-wanding. Quotation MCP runtime node_modules are packaged. Field test found AionUI can still use a stale %APPDATA% runtime ACP cache and show 'undetected Claude Code' even when Check Install has no MISSING. Fixed by shipping sync-aionui-ccb-route-b.ps1, running it from run-wanding-bootstrap.ps1 on every Quick/Full bootstrap, and making ccb-check-install.cmd run Quick bootstrap plus verify OK bundled route-b and OK runtime route-b. Latest CCB-Wanding-1.0.1.exe SHA256 0566D3439A84D0DD1167F82689E279DA6CC7828289E9575A106E08046EF4B15E, size 948246404 bytes. Staging bootstrap route-b sync passed with temp APPDATA; staged Check Install reports OK runtime route-b; staged MCP -Probe passed for quotation/accurate/office-word/excel. Baseline decision: this route-b cache fix needs one new full NSIS because older installs lack self-heal; after this baseline, backend-only components (dist/python/data/seed/quotation-mcp/accurate-mcp/office-word/excel/mcp-pip) can use hot-update zip, while AionUI/frontend/installer/launcher/vendor-runtime/new-machine cases still need full NSIS. Remaining highest-confidence gap: no clean-VM AionUI GUI click-through after this route-b cache fix.
